mapper.select: select FINPROD_ID finprodId ,BALANCE_DATE balanceDate ,SUBJECT_NO subjectNo ,BOOKSET_ID booksetId ,FSUBJECT_NO fsubjectNo ,SUBJECT_LEVEL subjectLevel ,BAL_FLAG balFlag ,O_CCY oCcy ,O_AMT oAmt ,B_CCY bCcy ,B_AMT bAmt ,IS_LEAF isLeaf ,NUM_AMT numAmt ,CREATE_USER createUser ,CREATE_DEPT createDept ,CREATE_TIME createTime ,UPDATE_USER updateUser ,UPDATE_TIME updateTime from BOK_BANK_POSITION where BALANCE_DATE = #{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT B.BUSI_ID AS finprodId, A.BOOK_DATE AS balanceDate, B.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, B.CD_FLAG AS balFlag, B.CCY AS oCcy, B.HAPPEN_AMT AS oAmt, B.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS numAmt, B.B_HAPPEN_AMT AS bAmt, B.B_CCY AS bCcy, ( CASE WHEN B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN B.SUBJECT_NO ELSE C.FSUBJECT_ID END ) AS fsubjectId, ( CASE WHEN B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN #{bottomLevel} ELSE C.SUBJECT_LEVEL END ) AS subjectLevel, 'Y' AS isleaf FROM BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL B JOIN BOK_VOUCH_MAIN A ON A.VOUCH_NUM = B.VOUCH_NUM LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND C.SUBJECT_NO = B.SUBJECT_NO WHERE A.BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT bs.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, bs.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, bs.FSUBJECT_ID AS fsubjectId, bs.SUBJECT_LEVEL AS subjectLevel, bs.BAL_FLAG AS balFlag FROM BOK_SUBJECT bs,BOK_BOOKSET bb WHERE bb.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL
